Services

I don't deliver the latest in super-artificial-intelligence-fueled, cutting-edge innovations. Instead, I provide a fully functional, reliable and maintainable solution tailored precisely to your requirements. Vəssalam.

Architecture Advisory

Know your risks and your target architecture before a large investment.

A fit if you are preparing a major build, a vendor decision or a modernization, or if outages and slow releases have become a business problem, and you do not need a full-time enterprise architect.

  • Architecture review with risks ranked by business impact
  • Security architecture review
  • Design of fault-tolerant core systems
  • Target architecture and a roadmap your team can execute

Fractional Technical Leadership

Senior technical judgment without a full-time executive hire.

A fit if technical decisions are piling up on a founder or CEO, if you depend on vendors you cannot fully assess, or if you are building your first engineering team.

  • Technology and architecture decisions
  • Vendor selection and evaluation
  • Technical hiring and team setup
  • Delivery oversight: quality, risk and timelines

End-to-End Development

From an idea to production and handover, built by the person who designed it.

A fit if you have a clear business need and want one accountable person rather than a vendor team.

  • Design, development and testing
  • Deployment into production with monitoring and a rollback plan
  • Documentation and handover, so your team owns the result

You work directly with me — from discovery to handover

No account managers and no hand-offs. The person you talk to is the person who does the work.

What I don't do

  • Penetration tests and security certification. These belong with an independent firm.
  • Large delivery teams. If you need fifteen people, you need a different kind of partner.
  • Staff augmentation: supplying developers to work under your management.

Tell me briefly what you are building and what worries you. Pricing follows once I understand the scope.
